name: Oota Nagisa
source: Mother of protagonist runs a flower shop while not best shop it does well because she attracts people. Has a big libido but her husband is away on work. After being caught by son he offers to help her with libido.
translation: 主人公的母亲经营一家花店。虽然算不上最好的花店，但因为她很能吸引客人，生意还不错。她性欲旺盛，可丈夫常因工作不在家。被儿子发现后，儿子主动提出帮助她解决性欲问题。
